stories.title: 'Beyond anyone I've ever seen': Inside Patrick Mahomes' long road back
stories.summary: Exactly 274 days ago, Mahomes, after suffering the most significant injury of his career, vowed to be back for Week 1. Here's how he did it.

stories.title: These Broncos have striking resemblance to Denver's last Super Bowl winners
stories.summary: The 2015 Broncos used a united front office, shutdown defense and clutch play to win Super Bowl 50.

stories.title: Sources: Clippers, Raptors complete trade sending Leonard to Toronto
stories.summary: The Clippers and Raptors have both agreed to complete the blockbuster trade that will send Kawhi Leonard back to Toronto, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Patriots' Kraft on Macklemore: Won't provide platform for 'hate speech'
stories.summary: Robert Kraft said he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due in part to a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."

stories.title: Vikings' O'Connell says he doesn't fault Packers for hit on Murray
stories.summary: The hit that caused Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray's concussion was a "violent, physical play" but was not objectionable, coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday.
